result.stdout:
========================================================
    HeroParser CLI — High-Performance & AI-Native       
========================================================

Usage: heroparser <command> [arguments] [options]

Commands:
  detect <file>                Auto-detect delimiter and encoding of a CSV file
  validate <file>              Validate CSV structure and columns consistency
  profile <file>               Generate a Markdown statistical profile card of columns
  convert <input> <output>     Convert between CSV, JSONL, Fixed-Width, and Excel
  repair <input> <output>      Repair markdown blocks and unclosed quotes in LLM output
  schema <file>                Infer CSV schema and generate a C# record class model
  query/ask <file> <prompt>    [AI] Ask natural language questions about your dataset
  translate <file> <prompt>    [AI] Transform, translate, or map rows using LLM prompts

Global Options:
  -d, --delimiter <char>       Set CSV delimiter (e.g. , ; | or \t)
  -s, --sheet <name>           Sheet name to process for Excel files
  -o, --output <path>          Path to output file (required for convert/repair/translate)

AI-Native Options:
  -ai, --ai                    Enable AI optimizations (in 'schema' command)
  -p, --ai-provider <name>     Select local AI CLI provider: google (default), openai, anthropic, microsoft, github, ollama
  -k, --ai-key <key>           Not needed for local CLI providers (retained for compatibility)
  -m, --model <name>           Specify custom LLM model name
  -b, --batch-size <num>       Batch size of records sent to LLM in translation (default: 50)

Try 'heroparser <command> --help' for detailed instructions on a command.
========================================================
